20261121-physics-g04-2.steps.0.prompt: Xa kukhutshwa isikhonkwane esiqinileyo ebhodini leplanga ngesando sokukhupha izikhonkwane, kutheni kufuneka amandla amancinci xa ubambe ekupheleni kwesibambo kunokuba ubambe embindini, yintoni isizathu sesayensi?
20261121-physics-g04-2.steps.0.explain: Ekhefini, xa umgama phakathi kwephoyinti yokuxhasa nephoyinti yamandla mde, amandla amancinci anokudlulisela amandla amakhulu kwindawo yokusebenza, ngoko kulula ukukhupha isikhonkwane.
20261121-physics-g04-2.steps.0.hints.1: Xa umgama phakathi kwephoyinti yokuxhasa nephoyinti yamandla mkhulu, amandla amancinci anokuvelisa amandla amakhulu.

20261122-physics-g04-1.title: amandla owafaka ngesandla ayancipha
20261122-physics-g04-1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-amandla owafaka ngesandla ayancipha ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-physics-g04-1.material: Xa uthatha ikhefu lokuphakamisa idwala elinzima, ukuba uyibeka iphoyinti yokuxhasa ngaphambili kwedwala (indawo yokusebenza), amandla owafaka ngesandla ayancipha, kodwa umgama owuhambayo isandla utshintsha njani?
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.prompt: Xa uthatha ikhefu lokuphakamisa idwala elinzima, ukuba uyibeka iphoyinti yokuxhasa ngaphambili kwedwala (indawo yokusebenza), amandla owafaka ngesandla ayancipha, kodwa umgama owuhambayo isandla utshintsha njani?
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.explain: Ngokusebenzisa ikhefu amandla anganciphisa, kodwa umgama ekufuneka usuke ngawo isandla uyanda ngokuyilingana, ngoko isixa sakho somsebenzi siyagcinwa (umgaqo womsebenzi).
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.hint.0: Xa usebenzisa ikhefu ufumana inzuzo emandleni, uphulukana emgameni.
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.hint.1: Oku kubizwa ngokuba ngumgaqo womsebenzi kwifiziksi.
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.o.o0: Umgama ekufuneka usuke ngawo isandla uyanda
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.o.o1: Umgama ekufuneka usuke ngawo isandla uyancipha nawo

20261122-physics-g04-2.title: Kutheni kusenziwa lula ukuhambisa umthwalo
20261122-physics-g04-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Kutheni kusenziwa lula ukuhambisa umthwalo ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-physics-g04-2.material: Kutheni kusenziwa lula ukuhambisa umthwalo onzima ngokuwubeka kwisithuthuthu esinamavili nokuwutyhala kunokuwurhuqa phantsi?
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.prompt: Kutheni kusenziwa lula ukuhambisa umthwalo onzima ngokuwubeka kwisithuthuthu esinamavili nokuwutyhala kunokuwurhuqa phantsi?
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.explain: Xa kusetyenziswa iivili, ukungqubana kokushiyela phakathi komhlaba nento kuguqulwa kube kokungqubana kokujikeleza okuncinci kakhulu, ngoko amandla okungqubana ayasichasa ukushukuma ancipha kakhulu.
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukungqubana xa into ishiyela noxa ivili lijikeleza.
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.o.o0: Kuba xa ivili lijikeleza, 'amandla okungqubana kokujikeleza' aba mancinane kunamandla okungqubana kokushiyela
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.o.o1: Kuba iivili zinciphisa ubunzima bomthwalo ukuya ku-1/10
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.o.o2: Kuba umxhuzulane woMhlaba uyanyamalala phezu kwevili
